examShortTricks: Trick 1: Biofertilizer bank: Rhizobium (legume nodules), Azotobacter/Azospirillum (free-living), blue-green algae Anabaena/Nostoc (rice fields), mycorrhiza (Glomus — P uptake, drought resistance) — four classes with roles.
Trick 2: Organic farming triad: organic manures/compost, biofertilizers, IPM (biocontrol) instead of chemicals — the sustainable package.
Trick 3: Merits: cheaper, renewable, no soil/water pollution, maintain soil fertility long-term — four merits for the 2-mark answer.
Trick 4: Cyanobacteria fix ~significant N in paddy — the rice-specific application.
